item.title: CVE-2026-104904 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5
item.description: Saturday 21 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5 | The Shortcodes Ultimate plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Local File Inclusion in versions up to, and including, 7.9.1 This is due to su_get_current_url() interpolating the raw Host request header into the authority portion of a URL that is then passed to esc_url() — which by design preserves '[' and ']' inside the authority so IPv6 literal hosts remain valid — and the [su_qrcode] shortcode substituting that value into its data attribute (the documented %CURRENT_URL% token) before feeding it to do_shortcode(). This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to include arbitrary PHP files that reside within the active theme's root directory (bounded because '/' inside an attribute value terminates parse_url()'s host and is then percent-encoded and stripped), and — when the shipped-default 'Unsafe features' option remains on — to read arbitrary post meta of any post, on any front-end page that renders [su_qrcode data="%CURRENT_URL%"].

item.title: CVE-2026-107713 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2
item.description: Saturday 21 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2 | The Flutterwave Payments plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'form_id' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.0.7 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The storing endpoint is accessible without authentication because the required nonce is publicly exposed on any front-end page rendering the plugin's [flw-pay-form], [flw-pay-button], or [flw-donation-form] shortcodes, allowing any unauthenticated visitor to scrape and reuse it.

item.title: CVE-2026-116619 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2
item.description: Saturday 21 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2 | The MetForm – Contact Form, Survey, Quiz, Conditional Forms, Form Templates & Custom Form Builder for Elementor plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'mf-te (the form-builder-chosen name of the Text Editor field)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.3.3 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Successful exploitation requires a published form containing a Text Editor block; the form's public markup exposes the submission nonce as data-form-nonce, allowing any unauthenticated visitor to satisfy the only submission barrier and store the malicious payload.

item.title: CVE-2026-118059 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 5.4
item.description: Saturday 21 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 5.4 | The MailerLite – Signup forms (official) plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'form_id' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.7.27 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. item.title: CVE-2026-119632 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2
item.description: Saturday 21 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2 | The Forminator Forms – Contact Form, Payment Form & Custom Form Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'textarea-N (rich-text draft value, saved as Save-and-Continue draft meta)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.58.4 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This requires the targeted form to have a Rich-Text Textarea field with Save-and-Continue enabled and public submission permissions — once a crafted draft is saved, the payload executes whenever any user, including an administrator, resumes the draft or opens the Draft ID link from the Forminator Submissions screen.

item.title: CVE-2026-120485 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2
item.description: Saturday 21 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2 | The Admin Columns plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'url' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 7.1.8 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. item.title: CVE-2026-120486 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 5.4
item.description: Saturday 21 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 5.4 | The ShortPixel Image Optimizer – Optimize Images, Convert WebP & AVIF plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 6.6.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation requires the administrator to have enabled the 'Deliver WebP/AVIF images using the ShortPixel CDN' (useCDN) option, after which any unauthenticated visitor can submit a comment containing a crafted url() payload inside an allowed HTML construct such as <acronym title="...">, which WordPress comment kses preserves on save; the dangerous attribute-boundary breakout occurs only at render time inside the ob_start output-buffer rewriter, where kses does not apply.

item.title: CVE-2026-120529 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2
item.description: Saturday 21 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2 | The Admin Columns plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'HTTP_USER_AGENT' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 7.1.7 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The kses sanitization pass in classes/Sanitize/Kses.php uses wp_kses_allowed_html('post') augmented with iframe[src] and the data: protocol; because wp_kses_attr_check accepts any data-* attribute on any allowed tag without inspecting its value, a payload embedded inside a data-ac-tip attribute survives intact and is subsequently assigned to innerHTML by assets/js/table.js, bypassing the apparent mitigation entirely.

item.title: CVE-2026-120676 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2
item.description: Saturday 21 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2 | The Forminator Forms – Contact Form, Payment Form & Custom Form Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'upload-1 (the File Upload field's element_id)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.58.4 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This vulnerability is an incomplete fix for CVE-2024-1794; exploitation requires that the Forminator form's File Upload field is left at plugin defaults (no 'custom-files' restriction configured) and that the server maps no Content-Type to the .rtx extension — the default behavior of the Debian/Ubuntu Apache package used by the official WordPress Docker image and many shared hosts.

item.title: CVE-2026-120679 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 5.4
item.description: Saturday 21 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 5.4 | The Redux Framework plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the '<opt_name>[<color-field-id>]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.5.17 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The wp_kses_post() sanitization applied via Redux_Helpers::sanitize_array() is bypassed — not broken — because an <a class="thickbox" title="&lt;img onerror=...&gt;"> payload uses only kses-allowed tags and attributes, with the entity-encoded onerror handler surviving storage as inert text that the browser decodes when WordPress core's thickbox.js reads the title attribute and writes it into the modal as HTML. Successful exploitation additionally requires an action by an administrator — the attacker cannot trigger the vulnerability on their own.

item.title: CVE-2026-120738 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.4
item.description: Saturday 21 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.4 | The Organize Media Folder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'EXIF.DateTimeOriginal' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.00 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This bypass of wp_filter_post_kses means the injected payload survives regardless of the uploader's unfiltered_html capability; Subscriber-level access becomes sufficient when a front-end attachment-upload integration such as bbPress with forumAttachments is active, and exploitation requires no special configuration because the %created_timestamp% placeholder is included in the caption template by default. Exploitation by attackers with subscriber-level access and above requires that bbPress and gd-bbpress-attachments (forumAttachments) are installed and configured so that Subscribers/Participants can post attachments through a frontend forum form. On a default installation, where that is not configured, the vulnerability requires attackers with author-level access and above.

item.title: CVE-2026-125039 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2
item.description: Saturday 21 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2 | The EZ SQL Reports Shortcode Widget and DB Backup plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'User-Agent header (stored to comment_agent)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 5.26.45 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Successful exploitation requires that an administrator has saved a report whose SQL query selects attacker-controlled data such as comment_agent, and that the attacker can identify the saved report's slug — a condition trivially met when the administrator publishes the report on a public page via the [SQLREPORT] shortcode.

item.title: CVE-2026-126011 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2
item.description: Saturday 21 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2 | The Photo Gallery, Sliders, Proofing and Themes – NextGEN Gallery plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.5.6 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This requires the site administrator to have configured the Thickbox lightbox effect with the "Try to apply to all images" context (thumbEffectContext=all_images), and exploitation additionally depends on an administrator approving the attacker's initial comment so that subsequent comments from that author are auto-approved.

item.title: CVE-2026-130150 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 4.7
item.description: Saturday 21 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 4.7 | The Product Import Export for WooCommerce – CSV Product Importer & Exporter plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'author (initial store via wp-comments-post.php) / CSV cell on import' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.6.9 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The exploit requires an administrator to approve the attacker's review, then export and re-import it using the plugin's default column mapping, with the import taking the INSERT branch — which occurs automatically on any site whose database table prefix is not the literal 'wp_', when the CSV has no comment_ID mapping, or when the original review has been trashed. Successful exploitation additionally requires an action by an administrator — the attacker cannot trigger the vulnerability on their own.

item.title: CVE-2026-131822 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2
item.description: Saturday 21 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2 | The Contact Form to Any API plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'your-message (any CF7 form field)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.0.7 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. item.title: CVE-2026-132620 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2
item.description: Saturday 21 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2 | The WPBot – AI ChatBot for WordPress & Growth Suite: SEO, AI Writer, Email Marketing, Social Media plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'text' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 9.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. item.description: Saturday 21 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2 | The BlockStrap Page Builder – Bootstrap Blocks plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 0.1.65 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. item.title: CVE-2026-133369 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.4
item.description: Saturday 21 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.4 | The CodePeople Post Map for Google Maps plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'cpm_map[api_key]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.3.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. item.title: CVE-2026-96991 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2
item.description: Saturday 21 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2 | The SchemaEngine AI – AI Schema Markup, Reviews & Rich Snippets for SEO plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via Comment Content via WebPage JSON-LD Description in all versions up to, and including, 3.1.3 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. item.title: CVE-2026-125054 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2
item.description: Saturday 21 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2 | The SiteOrigin CSS plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting via the 'class' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.6.9 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. item.title: CVE-2026-133963 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3

item.title: CVE-2026-104013 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 5.9
item.description: Saturday 21 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 5.9 | The WP Compress – Instant Performance & Speed Optimization plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Directory Traversal in all versions up to, and including, 7.26.00 via the 'css' parameter parameter. item.title: CVE-2026-107632 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2
item.description: Saturday 21 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2 | The Unbounce Landing Pages plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting in versions up to, and including, 1.1.6. This is due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping on the proxy error message that is persisted to the 'ub-proxy-error-message' option: unauthenticated attacker-controlled REQUEST_URI data is concatenated into the error string in UBHTTP::stream_request_curl()/stream_request_wp_remote() and stored via update_option(), then later echoed inside a <textarea> on the Unbounce Pages Diagnostics admin page without any escaping. item.title: CVE-2026-116757 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.4
item.description: Saturday 21 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.4 | The Tutor LMS – eLearning and online course solution plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the '_tutor_profile_bio' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.2.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. item.title: CVE-2026-119114 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.4
item.description: Saturday 21 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.4 | The WP Fastest Cache – WordPress Cache Plugin plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to arbitrary directory deletion due to insufficient file path validation in the singleDeleteCache function in all versions up to, and including, 1.5.4 This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to delete arbitrary files on the server, which can easily lead to remote code execution when the right file is deleted (such as wp-config.php). item.title: CVE-2026-120119 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5
item.description: Saturday 21 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5 | The HUSKY – Products Filter for WooCommerce Professional plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to time-based SQL Injection via the 'link (inner 'woof_text' query parameter)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.4.7 due to insufficient escaping on the user supplied parameter and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query. item.title: CVE-2026-120743 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 4.7
item.description: Saturday 21 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 4.7 | The Simply Schedule Appointments plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'payment_method' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.6.13.4 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. The payload is planted via an unauthenticated guest checkout order's billing first name through the WooCommerce Store API, with execution triggered by a subsequent unauthenticated withdrawal request submission whose nonce is publicly available on the /withdraw-from-contract/ page.

item.title: CVE-2026-133367 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2
item.description: Saturday 21 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2 | The WPC Frequently Bought Together for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'variation' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 8.0.2 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The nonce protecting the woobt_add_all_to_cart AJAX handler is emitted to all unauthenticated visitors via wp_localize_script, effectively nullifying the nonce as an authentication barrier and making the handler reachable without any login.

item.title: CVE-2026-133964 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3
item.description: Saturday 21 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3 | A security vulnerability has been detected in Bytebase DBHub up to 2.0.0. Impacted is the function escapeHatchFunctionKeywords of the file src/utils/allowed-keywords.ts of the component Read Only Mode. The manipulation of the argument tool leads to incomplete blacklist. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

item.title: CVE-2026-87092 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5
item.description: Saturday 21 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5 | The Unlimited Elements For Elementor plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Directory Traversal in all versions up to, and including, 2.0.26 via the getFileContentByUrl function. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to read the contents of arbitrary files on the server, which can contain sensitive information. The nonce protecting the get_addon_output_data AJAX endpoint is emitted on the Elementor editor page, which is accessible to Contributors, making the endpoint reachable by any authenticated user at that privilege level or above.
